cards.altText: A beautiful protein model is still a model. STRUCTURAL BIOINFORMATICS Separate prediction from evidence. Large elegant ribbon sculpture on charcoal plinth with paper tag model; dramatic lighting.
cards.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Make ONE finished Instagram carousel card, SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio requested 1080x1080. Full bleed with 80px safe margins. ANGSUMI premium editorial identity: ivory #F7F2E8, maroon #6F2437, forest #304939, sage #94A58B, charcoal. Oversized expressive serif headline; clean readable sans-serif supporting text; generous space, compelling tactile three-dimensional paper scientific metaphor. Brand top ANGSUMI; footer @angsumi.online and supplied card number. Use only EXACT supplied headline and body and explicitly requested tiny conceptual label. No extra handwritten notes, slogans, equations, percentages, fake data, graph values, invented accession IDs or watermarks. Conceptual teaching illustrations, never pretend these are actual analysis results. No collage of several cards: one square card only. Topic structural-bioinformatics. Protein sculpture gallery: dimensional ivory and maroon ribbon model on charcoal cover, cream museum evidence labels, warm directional light. Card 1/6. Headline exact: "A beautiful protein model
is still a model.". Body exact: "STRUCTURAL BIOINFORMATICS
Separate prediction from evidence.". Visual: Large elegant ribbon sculpture on charcoal plinth with paper tag model; dramatic lighting.. Footer number "1/6".

cards.altText: Sequence. Structure. Function. Structural bioinformatics studies how these layers relate. Three ivory gallery labels sequence structure function beside a ribbon; no unqualified deterministic causal arrows.
